algorithm: ACT, Diffusion Policy, pi0.5, GR00T N1.5

note_gaps: No paper text states hand DoF for any of the 12 hands or a physics timestep/engine version; the code pins Isaac Sim 5.1.0 but this is a code-only fact. The repository's LICENSE file content was not captured, so licence type is unstated in both sources.
